# Daemon configuration reference

Every key `<PROMETHEUS_HOME>/daemon.toml` accepts: machine-wide settings shared by every profile of the home, never read from a profile's `config.toml`. Unknown keys are rejected.

`<name>` stands for any table name (a provider id, a model alias, a platform). Apply: `live` takes effect at once, `next_session` for sessions started afterwards, `restart` after the process restarts.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Apply | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `api_server.cors_origins` | array of string | `[]` | any | `restart` | Exact browser origins (`https://chat.example.com`) allowed to call the API; empty sends no CORS headers and refuses every request carrying an `Origin`. |
| `api_server.listen` | string | `"127.0.0.1:8642"` | any | `restart` | Where the API server listens. |
| `api_server.public` | boolean | `false` | any | `restart` | Allow a non-loopback `listen` address (logged at WARN on every start). |
| `api_server.public_host` | string | unset | any | `restart` | A host name accepted in the `Host` header besides the loopback names (a reverse proxy's name for a loopback listener). |
| `daemon.autostart` | boolean | `true` | any | `restart` | Interactive clients (`prometheus tui`, the ACP adapter) start the daemon detached when it is not running; `false` makes them exit 69 instead. |
| `daemon.idle_session_close_secs` | integer | `3600` | ≥ 1 | `restart` | A session with no attached client, no running turn, no open request and no queued input is closed after this many seconds. |
| `daemon.restart_drain_secs` | integer | `120` | ≥ 0 | `restart` | Seconds `prometheus daemon restart` waits for running turns to reach a turn boundary before it replaces the daemon anyway. |
| `daemon.rpc.bind` | string | `"127.0.0.1:0"` | any | `restart` | Listen address. Loopback only (`127.0.0.1`, `::1`); port `0` picks a free port, recorded as `rpc_url` in `run/gateway.json`. Remote access goes through the gateway relay, never this listener. |
| `daemon.rpc.max_frame_bytes` | integer | `16777216` | ≥ 1024 | `restart` | Largest accepted frame; a larger one closes the connection with 4413. |
| `daemon.rpc.request_timeout_secs` | integer | `600` | ≥ 1 | `restart` | Deadline of server-to-client requests other than approvals (which use the profile's `approvals.timeout_secs`). |
| `daemon.rpc.workers` | integer | `8` | 1 to 256 | `restart` | Requests run concurrently per connection; `rpc.ping` never waits for one. |
| `daemon.systemd_watchdog_secs` | integer | `0` | ≥ 0 | `restart` | Linux: `> 0` makes the generated systemd unit `Type=notify` with this `WatchdogSec`; the daemon notifies only while its watchdog probes succeed. `0` (default): no systemd watchdog. |
| `daemon.watchdog.enabled` | boolean | `true` | any | `restart` | Run the watchdog. |
| `daemon.watchdog.max_strikes` | integer | `3` | 1 to 100 | `restart` | Consecutive strikes before the dump and exit. |
| `daemon.watchdog.probe_interval_secs` | integer | `30` | 1 to 3600 | `restart` | Seconds between probes; a probe not answered within this is a strike. |
| `dashboard.auth.drivers` | array of string | `[]` | any | `restart` | Subjects that attach to sessions as drivers; every other remotely signed-in user is an observer (`password` is the password mode's subject). |
| `dashboard.auth.mode` | one of "none", "password", "oidc", "portal", "token" | `"none"` | `"none"`, `"password"`, `"oidc"`, `"portal"`, `"token"` | `restart` | The sign-in provider for remote browsers. |
| `dashboard.auth.oidc.allowed_subjects` | array of string | `[]` | any | `restart` | Subjects (`sub` claims) allowed to sign in. |
| `dashboard.auth.oidc.client_id` | string | unset | any | `restart` | The client id registered at the issuer. |
| `dashboard.auth.oidc.issuer` | string | unset | any | `restart` | The issuer URL (its `/.well-known/openid-configuration` is read). |
| `dashboard.auth.portal.client_id` | string | unset | any | `restart` | The dashboard's registered OAuth client at the account portal. |
| `dashboard.base_path` | string | `"/"` | any | `restart` | The path prefix the dashboard is served under (a reverse proxy's mount point, such as `/prometheus`). |
| `dashboard.host` | string | `"127.0.0.1"` | any | `restart` | The address the listener binds. Anything but a loopback address needs `auth.mode` and TLS. |
| `dashboard.max_upload_bytes` | integer | `26214400` | ≥ 0 | `restart` | The largest chat attachment upload. |
| `dashboard.port` | integer | `9120` | 0 to 65535 | `restart` | The port (`0`: chosen by the OS). |
| `dashboard.public_host` | string | unset | any | `restart` | A host name accepted in the `Host` header besides the bound names. |
| `dashboard.tls.cert` | string | unset | any | `restart` | The certificate chain. |
| `dashboard.tls.key` | string | unset | any | `restart` | The private key. |
| `dashboard.trust_proxy` | boolean | `false` | any | `restart` | Honour `X-Forwarded-*` headers from `trusted_proxies`. |
| `dashboard.trust_proxy_tls` | boolean | `false` | any | `restart` | A trusted proxy terminates TLS in front of a plain listener. |
| `dashboard.trusted_proxies` | array of string | `[]` | any | `restart` | Proxy addresses whose `X-Forwarded-*` headers are honoured. |
| `gateway.http.listen` | string | `"127.0.0.1:8644"` | any | `restart` | Where every webhook-style adapter is served, at `/p/<profile>/<platform>/`. |
| `gateway.http.public` | boolean | `false` | any | `restart` | Allow a non-loopback `listen` address (logged at WARN on every start). |
| `gateway.limits.max_concurrent_sessions` | integer | `0` | ≥ 0 | `restart` | Sessions with a running turn at once, across every profile and surface; further turns wait first in, first out ("Waiting for a free slot"). `0`: unbounded. |
| `gateway.limits.max_live_client_sessions` | integer | `16` | ≥ 0 | `restart` | Detached TUI, desktop and dashboard sessions kept loaded; the least recently active beyond it are unloaded (never one running a turn or with a client attached) and resumed from storage when reopened. `0`: no cap. |
| `gateway.on_all_adapters_down` | one of "stay_alive", "exit" | `"stay_alive"` | `"stay_alive"`, `"exit"` | `restart` | What the daemon does once every messaging adapter failed for good: keep serving local clients and schedulers, or exit 78. |
| `gateway.relay.allow_direct_platforms` | array of string | `[]` | any | `restart` | Platforms the relay fronts whose direct adapters still connect. |
| `gateway.relay.gateway_id` | string | unset | any | `restart` | This gateway's id at the connector. |
| `gateway.relay.token_secret` | string | `"PMT_RELAY_TOKEN"` | a secret name | `restart` | The secret holding the gateway credential `prometheus gateway enroll` obtained (never the value). |
| `gateway.relay.url` | string | unset | any | `restart` | The connector's WebSocket URL (`wss://`; `ws://` only to a loopback host). Unset: no relay. |
| `gateway.relay.wake_url` | string | unset | any | `restart` | An `https://` URL the connector calls to wake a scaled-to-zero host. |
| `local_runtime.backend` | one of "auto", "cuda", "metal", "vulkan", "hip", "cpu" | `"auto"` | `"auto"`, `"cuda"`, `"metal"`, `"vulkan"`, `"hip"`, `"cpu"` | `restart` | The engine build: `auto` picks one from the probed hardware. |
| `local_runtime.detect_ports` | array of integer | `[]` | any | `restart` | Ports probed for a user-run llama-server besides 8080. |
| `local_runtime.enabled` | boolean | `false` | any | `restart` | Let Prometheus start and supervise a `llama-server` when a session needs one. `false` (the default) only detects a running server. |
| `local_runtime.idle_unload_secs` | integer | `900` | ≥ 0 | `restart` | Seconds without a request after which a resident model is unloaded (it is reloaded by the next request). |
| `local_runtime.models_max` | integer | `4` | 1 to 16 | `restart` | Models kept resident at once. |
| `local_runtime.port` | integer | `0` | 0 to 65535 | `restart` | Loopback port of the managed server; `0` picks a free one at start. |
| `process.nofile_soft_limit` | integer | `4096` | ≥ 0 | `restart` | Open-file soft limit every process raises itself to at startup on POSIX hosts, capped by the hard limit and never lowering a higher limit; children inherit it. `0` disables the raise. |
| `runtimes.allow_lazy_install` | boolean | `true` | any | `restart` | Install a missing pinned runtime the first time a tool needs it (asking first on an interactive terminal). `false` makes the tool fail with a `prometheus runtimes install <name>` hint instead. |
| `runtimes.exclude` | array of string | `[]` | any | `restart` | Runtimes nothing may install: not lazily, not `prometheus runtimes install`, not the pin refresh after an update. `install.sh --without <name>` records names here. |
| `runtimes.mirrors.npm` | string | unset | any | `restart` | Node package registry (used by Node-based plugins, milestone M2). |
| `runtimes.mirrors.pypi` | string | unset | any | `restart` | Python package index for the Python bridge's packages (used by the bridge, milestone M2). |
| `runtimes.mirrors.runtimes` | string | unset | any | `restart` | Runtime archives: `<url>/<name>/<version>/<archive file name>`. |
| `update.allow_from_chat` | boolean | `false` | any | `restart` | Let gateway admins run `/update` from a chat. |
| `update.auto_apply` | boolean | `false` | any | `restart` | Install a release found by the background check without asking. |
| `update.check_interval_secs` | integer | `86400` | ≥ 0 | `restart` | Seconds between background checks for a newer release; `0` disables them. A check sends only the version and target (in the user agent). |
| `update.drain_timeout_secs` | integer | `120` | 1 to 86400 | `restart` | How long an update waits for a running daemon's turns to finish before restarting it on the new build; when they are still running the daemon keeps the old build and the update reports `daemon_restart_pending`. |
| `update.mirror_fallback` | boolean | `false` | any | `restart` | When a mirror (`update.mirror_url`, `runtimes.mirrors.runtimes`) still fails after the retry budget, download from the default origin instead of failing. |
| `update.mirror_url` | string | unset | any | `restart` | Base URL serving release indexes and archives in place of the default origin (`<url>/channels/<channel>.json`, `<url>/<tag>/release-manifest.json`, ...). Everything downloaded from it is still verified against the embedded release keys. |
| `update.pre_update_backup` | one of "state", "full", "off" | `"state"` | `"state"`, `"full"`, `"off"` | `restart` | What to save before the binary is swapped. |
| `update.require_transparency_log` | boolean | `false` | any | `restart` | Also require a keyless transparency-log signature on every release file, as a second check after the embedded-key signature. |
| `update.snapshot_keep` | integer | `3` | 1 to 100 | `restart` | How many `pre-update` snapshots each profile keeps. |
